Have you heard the last variety of American Lion hunting – writing to ask for a bit of one’s dress to put into a literary quilt? I actually had such a request, and while I was laughing at it I came on a book of [Miss Alcott](../persons.html#1649)’s where the dear Jo – after she had become a noted authoress – has the same entreaty made to her.
